scenes.text: In 1930, a fur trapper reached a village of three hundred people.
Every door was open. Every stove was cold but full.
Meals sat half-eaten on the tables.
The sled dogs were still tethered. They had not been fed for days.
No one has ever explained where three hundred people went.
Follow Unsolved Archive for the next file.
